recap:
What a day at the Artemisa Demo Open! Mateo Benítez put on a clinic in Compound Bow Men, firing a tournament-best 323 points with a jaw-dropping 16 tens and 2 Xs to win by a commanding 13 points over Lucas Ferreira (310). The battle for third couldn't have been tighter: Diego Acosta took it with 303, just one point ahead of Tomás Rivas, whose 4 Xs weren't quite enough to close the gap.

Compound Bow Women delivered pure drama. Camila Duarte and Valentina Ortiz finished dead level on 318 points, and Camila took the top spot with 14 tens to Valentina's 11, even though Valentina hit 5 Xs. Sofía Giménez was right in the mix at 309 and led the field with 6 Xs.

Recurve was just as thrilling. Nicolás Vera took the Men's title with 299, holding off Gabriel Ramírez (294), whose 6 tens were the most in the category. In Recurve Bow Women, Lucía Fernández and Isabella Romero also finished tied on 297, and Lucía's 5 tens and 4 Xs put her on top. Two ties at the summit and razor-thin margins throughout made for an unforgettable Open!
